claude_proposed_widenings.name: RecoverSpellSlotsEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Part 2 of the feature recovers expended spell slots on a short rest, up to a combined level cap (ceil(druidLevel/2)) with an individual slot level ceiling (< 6). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers slot recovery.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+

claude_proposed_widenings.name: FreeSpellCastEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Part 1 grants a free cast of a prepared spell from a named source (Circle Spells) without expending a spell slot. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers slot-free casting. This is distinct from grant_spell_access (which covers access) and from heal_hp or grant_extra_action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: short_rest_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Part 2 is triggered by finishing a Short Rest, not by a free or bonus-action cost during a turn. The existing ClassFeatureActivationCost union (free | bonus_action) has no rest-event activation mode.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CompoundClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Recovery bundles two independent sub-features under one feature record, each with its own resource (use_count=1) and reset cadence (both Long Rest). The current ClassFeatureActivationMechanics carries a single effect. Encoding this unit honestly requires either an array of activations or a compound family variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The feature text has two paragraphs describing two fully independent mechanics: a free-cast clause (para 1) and a slot-recovery clause (para 2), each with separate reset conditions.
